title: Director of Engineering, Global Manufacturing Engineering & NPI
text:
The Director of Engineering leads Manufacturing Engineering, Process Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Test Engineering, Test Automation, NPI Engineering, and Customer TPM teams for a global data center rack manufacturing business. This role is responsible for engineering execution at the New Jersey manufacturing campus and for establishing global engineering standards, processes, and best practices across all manufacturing locations.

The Director drives manufacturing readiness, automation, operational excellence, quality, productivity, and successful new product introductions while partnering closely with customers and Platform Engineering. Platform Engineering retains ownership of product design, architecture, DFM approval, and Level 3 technical solutioning.

 

**Key Responsibilities**

**Manufacturing Engineering Leadership**

* Lead Manufacturing Engineering, Test Engineering, Test Automation, NPI Engineering, Industrial Engineering, and Customer TPM organizations.
* Establish and deploy global engineering standards, SOPs, governance, and best practices.
* Develop engineering talent, succession plans, and organizational capability.

**Manufacturing Excellence**

* Own engineering performance for the New Jersey campus and drive global engineering consistency.
* Optimize manufacturing flows, capacity, labor efficiency, throughput, and cycle time.
* Deliver improvements in FPY, RTPY, DPPM, OEE, cost, quality, and delivery performance.
* Drive KPI management systems and operational review rigor.

**Automation & Test Strategy**

* Define and execute factory automation and smart manufacturing roadmaps.
* Lead deployment of robotics, vision systems, automated assembly, digital manufacturing, and Industry 4.0 solutions.
* Own manufacturing test strategy, test automation, diagnostics, traceability, and test system scalability.

**New Product Introduction (NPI)**

* Own manufacturing readiness throughout all NPI phase gates.
* Ensure readiness of processes, tooling, automation, test systems, capacity, and staffing.
* Lead pilot builds, manufacturing validation, launch readiness reviews, and production ramps.
* Identify and mitigate manufacturing risks to schedule, quality, and scalability.

**Customer & Cross-Functional Leadership**

* Lead customer-facing TPM teams and serve as executive engineering interface for strategic customers.
* Partner with Operations, Quality, Supply Chain, Customers, and Platform Engineering to achieve successful product launches.
* Align manufacturing capabilities with customer requirements and growth plans.

**Continuous Improvement**

* Drive Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, Root Cause Analysis, CAPA, and SPC methodologies.
* Lead cost reduction, productivity, yield improvement, and waste elimination initiatives.
Build a culture of accountability, standardization, and continuous improvement. 

 

**Ownership & Interfaces**

**This Role Owns**

* Manufacturing Engineering
* Process Engineering
* Industrial Engineering
* Test Engineering
* Test Automation
* Manufacturing readiness
* Factory readiness
* SOPs and engineering standards
* FPY, RTPY, DPPM, productivity, throughput, and operational KPIs
* Manufacturing validation and production ramp execution
Customer TPM organization 

 

**Partner Organizations**

**Platform Engineering**

* Product architecture and design
* Product specifications and BOM ownership
* DFM/DFA approval
* Product validation and qualification
* Design changes and reliability engineering
* Level 3 debugging, root cause analysis, and technical solution development

**Customers**

* Product requirements
* Acceptance criteria
* Product roadmap priorities
* Qualification and approval requirements

**Key Metrics**

* First Pass Yield (FPY)
* Rolled Throughput Yield (RTPY)
* DPPM
* Cost of Poor Quality (COPQ)
* On-Time Delivery (OTD)
* Productivity and labor efficiency
* Manufacturing cycle time
* Automation ROI
* NPI launch success
* Customer satisfaction
Global standards adoption 

 

**Qualifications**

* BS in Engineering required; MS/MBA preferred.
* 15+ years of manufacturing engineering leadership experience.
* Experience leading Manufacturing Engineering, Test Engineering, Automation, and NPI organizations.
* Proven success in high-volume electronics, server, rack integration, or data center manufacturing environments.
* Strong customer-facing leadership skills.
* Demonstrated track record improving FPY, RTPY, quality, productivity, and operational performance.
Lean Six Sigma and global manufacturing experience preferred. 

 

**Ideal Candidate**

A strategic and hands-on engineering leader capable of building a world-class global manufacturing engineering organization that delivers scalable NPI execution, advanced automation, operational excellence, and industry-leading quality for hyperscale and enterprise data center infrastructure products.

**About ZT Systems**
--------------------

At ZT Systems, a Sanmina Company, you’ll get to do work you are proud of alongside smart, passionate people. Every day, there are opportunities to collaborate with the best in the industry to design, build, and deliver impactful solutions to world-class customers. Along the way, you will gain hands-on experience in a fast-paced environment that’s challenging, rewarding, and career-defining.

A culture built around our values we work hard and think fast. We view challenges as opportunities—to do better, push harder, and be faster than we were the day before. When we fail, we learn from it and move on together. And when we succeed, we use the momentum to go even further. We create value with everything we do, building the foundation of today—and transforming the future of tomorrow.

Join ZT Systems and help us build technology infrastructure that connects the world.

**What We Offer** 
At ZT Systems, a Sanmina Company, we believe that investing in our people is key to our continued growth and innovation. When you join our team, you’ll gain access to a comprehensive and inclusive benefits package designed to support your well-being, financial security, and professional development—both now and in the future.

**Compensation & Financial Security**

* Competitive base salary

* Performance-based annual bonus eligibility

* 401(k) retirement savings plan

* Tuition reimbursement for eligible education programs

**Health & Wellness**

* Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage with access to leading providers

-Mental health resources and employee wellness support programs-

* Company-paid life and disability insurance

**Time Away & Work-Life Balance**

* Paid time off (PTO) and company-paid holidays

* Parental leave and family care support programs

**Growth & Purpose**

* Structured training programs and on-the-job learning opportunities

* Matching gifts and volunteer programs to support causes you care about

These benefits are available to eligible employees and are designed to grow with you as your career evolves. Full benefits and eligibility varies by work location.
